data.name: Soul Machine
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the apocalypse. You are the last line of defense against an endless, self-replicating mechanical threat known as The Swarm.

BUILD YOUR ULTIMATE WAR MACHINE You are not just a soldier; you are the pilot of a highly customizable mechanical beast. Choose your mobility base—from agile bipedal legs to heavy tank treads and multi-legged spider chassis—and adapt your movement to your playstyle to outmaneuver the rogue mechs.

DEVASTATING WEAPON SYNERGIES Firepower is your only friend. Throughout your run, draft and upgrade heavily modifiable weapons. Turn a simple blaster into a chain-lightning shotgun, or craft a focused laser array that aggressively targets the closest machines. The weapon behavior system allows you to create exponentially destructive combinations to melt through armored hulls.

SURVIVE, DIE, EVOLVE The swarm is relentless, and destruction is inevitable. But every shattered robot leaves behind precious data and scrap. Harvest these resources to permanently upgrade your mech in the Meta-Progression timeline. Unlock new max weapon ranks, expand your passive slots, and boost your chassis' stats to push deeper into the horde on your next attempt.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Intense Rogue-lite Action: Fast-paced, top-down twin-stick combat against hundreds of rogue machines simultaneously.

  • Deep Arsenal: Combine distinct firing behaviors (Cone, Radial, Focused, Targeted) and pierce modifiers to build the perfect loadout.

  • Visceral Combat: Experience explosive physics-based combat where enemy mechs are blown into scrap metal amidst stunning VFX.

  • Permanent Progression: A deep meta-timeline that ensures every destroyed chassis paves the way for a stronger replacement.
